description: This file contains server-side load function to fetch data for the 'New Invoice' page, as well as an action handler to create a new invoice. It interacts with API endpoints to gather account, contact, and template data, transforms the data, and processes form submissions to create invoices with various details.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Server load function to retrieve necessary data such as accounts, contacts, and templates for invoice creation, decoding various API response formats and applying defaults.

methods.name: actions.create
methods.description: Handles the form submission to create a new invoice, including validation, data parsing, and invoking API to save the invoice.
